scenario: The ego vehicle travels along a curved rural road and collides head-on with a white microvan that drifts into the oncoming lane while rounding a blind corner.

ego.behavior: The car travels forward along a curved rural road and attempts to avoid a collision when an oncoming vehicle enters its lane.

adversarials.behavior: The white microvan rounds a blind corner and drifts entirely into the oncoming lane, causing a head-on collision with the ego vehicle.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle travels on a curved two-lane rural road with trees and buildings on both sides, while the adversarial white microvan approaches from the opposite direction around a blind corner and crosses into the ego's lane.
requirements_and_restrictions: The scenario involves a blind corner on a curved rural road with limited visibility; the collision occurs when the adversarial vehicle enters the oncoming lane.

road_side_structures.position: Visible on the left side of the road near the curve in the distance.

Evidence: The microvan's position shifts from its own lane into the ego's lane across frames; the ego's forward path is completely blocked.
